text: Mobile app development is an exciting field with many important decisions. One key choice is between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one system, while cross-platform apps work on several devices, saving time and money. Responsive design is also essential, as users expect apps to look good on different screen sizes. Once an app is ready, developers publish it through app stores like Google Play or the App Store. However, performance matters most: a slow app quickly loses users. Therefore, developers must test carefully, keep the design simple and make sure the app runs smoothly on every device.
